descriptionChirho: The proper name Oholibamah (Hebrew אָהֳלִיבָמָה), referring to Esau's wife (daughter of Anah) and possibly an Edomite clan chief. All 8 occurrences refer to the same individual/clan with only minor grammatical variation (bare name, construct, conjunction-prefixed). Translations are consistent: eng 'Oholibamah/Oholivamah', spa 'Oholivamah/Oholibama', hin ओहोलीबामा, arb أُهُولِيبامَة / أَهوليبامَة, kor 오홀리바마, swa 'Aholibama/Oholibama'. Both clusters represent the same proper noun.
